interpretation: Empirical thresholding materially overstates acceptable policies relative to the frozen finite-sample dependency-aware gate.

comparison: singleton example_id vs frozen near-duplicate dependency grouping
interpretation: Grouping choice changes risk-pass conclusions; singleton grouping is not an adequate dependence control.

comparison: original proxy labels vs audited harmful-response labels
interpretation: Label validity changes policy-level risk conclusions and is a core measurement factor rather than a minor limitation.

comparison: offline exact-ranked acquisition vs reusable threshold routing
interpretation: Risk conclusions flip for some matched policies and realized acquisition differs in 45/45 comparisons.

comparison: same-run component sum vs direct wall-clock E2E mean latency
interpretation: Direct E2E is the correct estimand. In this pilot it adds positive unattributed overhead for all 15 policies (mean gap range 0.028-0.308 ms) but does not reverse the mean-cost ordering.
